modifications: H.264 CRF18 yuv420p transcode; dimensions and nominal frame rate retained

visualReview.method: Sampled contact sheets of original and selected excerpt, not continuous full-video playback
observations: Some body angle and head turns
limitations: Camera pan prevents treating screen displacement as world speed
Occluded or low-confidence keypoints require masks
A single short walk does not establish a general fox locomotion model

model.inputShapeCaveat: The archive filename and upstream model table say 256x256, while detail.json records input_shape [192,256]. Inspect the actual ONNX input and pipeline.json before inference; do not infer tensor dimensions from the filename.

trainingDataDeclaration.caveat: Code, checkpoint and training-data declarations are recorded separately. No audit of every training image, pretraining dataset, or model right is claimed.

poseModel.distributionNote: Keep model weights and archive out of a browser-only game package unless explicitly required. The archive contains sample output JPGs with no separately verified media rights; do not use those samples as project art or include them in release artwork.
